scripts.translation: 通往^25C18D忍者公会^25C18D的秘密通道

scripts.text: You hear familiar voices talking to each other.
scripts.translation: 你听到熟悉的声音在交谈。

scripts.text: Long time, no see. How are you? How are the kids you've taken in?
scripts.translation: 好久不见。你最近怎么样？你收留的那些小孩还好吗？

scripts.text: I have to hand it to you. You've picked some competitive ones.
scripts.translation: 不得不承认，你挑的人很有竞争力。

scripts.text: Sounds like music to my ears. Being sent to a foreign land with air pollution was bad enough, now haunted with memories of this place...
scripts.translation: 这话真中听。被派到空气污染严重的异国已经够糟了，现在还要被这里的回忆纠缠...

scripts.text: What do you think? Should we rotate now?
scripts.translation: 你觉得呢？我们现在该轮换了吗？

scripts.text: Haven't given up, have ya. Do you really think he'll approve?
scripts.translation: 看来你还没放弃啊。你真觉得他会批准吗？

scripts.text: No need to be bitter. Hey! Were any of the kids that come and go here the ones that found the ^BD0408place^BD0408?
scripts.translation: 别酸了。对了！来来往往的那些孩子里，有人找到^BD0408那个地方^BD0408了吗？

scripts.text: Since finding the hidden place was also a part of the test.
scripts.translation: 毕竟发现那个隐藏的地方也是考验的一部分。

scripts.text: You are as stubborn as the first time I met you. It's just a wall in some place...
scripts.translation: 你还是和我初见你时一样固执。那不过是某个地方的一堵墙...

scripts.text: Shssh! I think someone is eavesdropping. Hurry! Go back to the mission area.
scripts.translation: 嘘！好像有人在偷听。快！回到任务区域去。

scripts.text: The conversation stopped abruptly. Hidden place? Wall? Part of a test? What is all this about?
scripts.translation: 对话突然停止了。隐藏的地方？墙？考验的一部分？这到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text: You should no longer use this secret passage.
scripts.translation: 你不应该再使用这条秘密通道了。

scripts.text: You found a location that resembles the hidden place.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一个与隐藏地点相似的地方。

scripts.text: This wall was here ever since. How come I didn't notice it before?
scripts.translation: 这堵墙一直都在这里。为什么我之前没注意到？

scripts.text: Now that I know it's a secret passage, what do I do to get in?
scripts.translation: 既然知道这是条秘密通道，我该怎么做才能进去？

scripts.text: Touch the drawing with your hand.
I can't rip it down because I don't own it.
scripts.translation: 我不能把它撕下来，因为它不是我的。

scripts.text: You touch the drawing with the tip of your hand and felt a sudden sensation of being pulled.
scripts.translation: 你用指尖碰了碰那幅画，突然感到一股拉力。

scripts.text: When touching the drawing, you get the feeling of being pulled...
scripts.translation: 触摸这幅画时，你会感到一股被拉扯的感觉...

scripts.text: There is a wall with a great drawing on it.
scripts.translation: 墙上画着一幅巨大的图画。

scripts.text: You don't need to carry so many things.
scripts.translation: 你不需要携带这么多东西。

scripts.text: You are not in the clan of the Ninja.
^1A95E6An old man looking hale and hearty is sitting and gazing vacantly.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6一位看起来精神矍铄的老人正坐着，目光呆滞地望着前方。^1A95E6

scripts.text: ^1A95E6You tried to talk to the old man but there is no response. Just when you are about to turn away...^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你试图与老人交谈，但他没有回应。就在你准备转身离开时...^1A95E6

scripts.text: At last, a customer! Hmm... and a live one, too!
scripts.translation: 总算有客人了！嗯...还是个活人！

scripts.text: ^1A95E6He keeps talking and doesn't stop to answer your question.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6他一直在说话，并没有停下来回答你的问题。^1A95E6

scripts.text: There once was a quiet clan living in ancient Amatsu times that is never mentioned in history books or stories.
scripts.translation: 在古老的樱花城时代，曾有一个安静的氏族，他们从未被记载在历史书籍或故事中。

scripts.text: They lived beneath shadows but always yearned for the bright sun, like a sunflower.
scripts.translation: 他们生活在阴影之下，却像向日葵一样，总是渴望明亮的阳光。

scripts.text: A clan that was loyal to their lord who they served as their bright sun.
scripts.translation: 这是一个忠于领主的氏族，他们将领主奉为太阳。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The old man looks at you with a melancholy face.^1A95E6
Why are you interested in a clan that was abandoned by their lord and disappeared from history itself?
scripts.translation: 为什么你要对一个被领主抛弃、甚至从历史中消失的氏族感兴趣呢？

scripts.text: Ninja! There was a time when the clan was called ninjas, too.
scripts.translation: 忍者！曾经，这个氏族也被称为忍者。

scripts.text: You'll have to lend me your ear for I have so much to tell you about the clan story.
scripts.translation: 请耐心听我说，关于这个氏族的故事，我有太多想告诉你的了。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The Old Man starts the story with a very soothing tone as if he is telling his grandchild a story.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人用非常柔和的语调开始讲述，就像在给孙辈讲故事一样。^1A95E6

scripts.text: This goes way back to ancient times and nobody in Amatsu remembers about it.
scripts.translation: 这要追溯到很久以前的古代，樱花城已经没有人记得这段历史了。

scripts.text: The clan worked behind the scenes and basically lived their lives for their lord.
scripts.translation: 这个氏族在幕后运作，基本上是为了领主而活。

scripts.text: They were very loyal doing whatever deed their lord asked for.
scripts.translation: 他们非常忠诚，领主吩咐什么，他们就做什么。

scripts.text: Ninja, the clan was known as the dark clan but that doesn't mean they wanted to be hidden in the darkness.
scripts.translation: 忍者，这个氏族被称为黑暗氏族，但这并不意味着他们想要隐藏在黑暗中。

scripts.text: They were loyal enough to be satisfied as the lord's servants but their loyalty became the problem.
scripts.translation: 他们足够忠诚，满足于做领主的仆人，但正是这种忠诚成了问题。

scripts.text: They are a secret organization that even the lord didn't know much about.
scripts.translation: 他们是一个秘密组织，连领主对他们知之甚少。

scripts.text: The few that knew about the clan's existence, tried to investigate them but nobody was able to reveal their true identity.
scripts.translation: 少数知晓这个氏族存在的人曾试图调查他们，却无人能揭开他们的真实身份。

scripts.text: That is why this clan has grown from loyal servants to a group feared for its secrets.
scripts.translation: 这就是为什么这个氏族从忠诚的仆人，变成了一个因秘密而令人恐惧的团体。

scripts.text: The lord shunned the clan and didn't call them for their service any more but they never betrayed him.
scripts.translation: 领主疏远了这个氏族，不再召唤他们服役，但他们从未背叛过他。
是的，他们很忠诚。非常忠诚。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The old man looks even more forlorn.^1A95E6
The clan has been living in hiding for so long since the old days. The current lord didn't even know of their existence.
scripts.translation: 自远古以来，这个氏族一直生活在隐匿之中。现任领主甚至不知道他们的存在。

scripts.text: I'm Leader Gion, the last of the dark ninja clan.
scripts.translation: 我是吉翁，黑暗忍者氏族最后的族人。

scripts.text: I think your time has ended.
scripts.translation: 我想你的时代已经结束了。

scripts.text: Are you an assassin to end this old man's life?
scripts.translation: 你是来取我这条老命的刺客吗？

scripts.text: So that is why you've shown interest in my clan. I won't give up easily.
scripts.translation: 原来你对我这个氏族这么感兴趣。我不会轻易放弃的。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6You lose conscience with the great impact.^000000
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你受到猛烈撞击，当场失去了意识。^000000

scripts.text: Been a long time since I last heard that word.
scripts.translation: 我已经很久没听到这个词了。

scripts.text: I guess this little visit was not by coincidence but a start of a connection.
scripts.translation: 看来这次短暂的相遇并非偶然，而是一段缘分的开始。

scripts.text: Sorry I am not a teacher. But!
I can help you on the path you've chosen, the ^33CC71{0}^000000 path.
scripts.translation: 我可以指引你走上你所选择的^33CC71{0}^000000之路。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6You hear Leader Gion's voice faintly as you slip away.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你在恍惚中听到首领吉翁的声音渐渐远去。^1A95E6

scripts.text: If you are prepared to follow me, Leader Gion, on the {0} path, we will meet again.
scripts.translation: 如果你准备好踏上{0}之路，跟随我继续修行，我们还会再见。

scripts.text: I thought you were afraid of the ^33CC71path of the {0}^33CC71 and wouldn't come back.
scripts.translation: 我还以为你害怕^33CC71{0}之路^33CC71，不会再回来了。

scripts.text: But from the look of your eyes, I guess I misjudged you.
scripts.translation: 但从你的眼神来看，看来是我看错你了。

scripts.text: You will have to train your mind and body to walk steadily in the unknown world and never fall into temptation to stay on the path.
scripts.translation: 你必须锤炼身心，才能在未知的世界中稳步前行，不受诱惑而偏离这条道路。

scripts.text: Our ancestors had 4 tests to train our people.
scripts.translation: 我们的祖先有四项考验来训练族人。

scripts.text: My ancestors trained my people with 4 tests that involve ^087FF8knowledge^000000, ^087FF8survival^000000, ^087FF8weapons^000000, and ^087FF8battle^000000.
scripts.translation: 我的祖先通过涉及^087FF8知识^000000、^087FF8生存^000000、^087FF8武器^000000和^087FF8战斗^000000的四项考验来训练族人。

scripts.text: I know you are curious what these tests are. Let me explain one by one.
scripts.translation: 我知道你很好奇这些考验是什么。让我逐一解释。

scripts.text: We need to be knowledgeable in order to assist the lord. This test is for this purpose.
scripts.translation: 我们需要具备知识来辅佐领主。这项考验正是为此而设。

scripts.text: You can pass the test if you successfully solve more than 9 out of 10 questions.
scripts.translation: 10道题答对9道以上即可通过考验。

scripts.text: The test will be easy to pass if you've been steady in your studies. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation: 如果你平时学习刻苦，这项考验会很容易通过。那么，你还想了解哪项考验？

scripts.text: Missions aren't always easy and safe. That is why survival instincts are vital to us.
scripts.translation: 任务并不总是轻松且安全的。因此，生存本能对我们至关重要。

scripts.text: My ancestors call this test the dice test. It is a test to advance forward depending on the dice results.
scripts.translation: 我的祖先称这项考验为“骰子考验”。它需要根据骰子的点数来决定前进的方向。

scripts.text: Think of it as the simple dice games people play.
scripts.translation: 你可以把它想象成人们常玩的简单骰子游戏。

scripts.text: But never let your guard down during the test because it isn't called the survival test for nothing.
scripts.translation: 但在考验中切勿掉以轻心，毕竟它被称为“生存考验”绝非没有道理。

scripts.text: There will be blocks that help you while there are blocks that will interrupt you.
scripts.translation: 有些格子会帮助你，也有些会阻碍你。

scripts.text: If you deal with various situations wisely, you will be able to pass the test. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation: 只要能明智地应对各种情况，就能通过考验。你还想了解哪项考验？

scripts.text: My clan was famous for using unique weapons that we created.
scripts.translation: 我的氏族以使用自制的独特武器而闻名。

scripts.text: You would be considered blessed if you created your own unique weapon.
scripts.translation: 如果你能打造出属于自己的独特武器，那将是一种荣幸。

scripts.text: Creating a weapon for yourself and refining it is the purpose of this test.
scripts.translation: 为自己打造武器并加以精炼，正是这项考验的目的。

scripts.text: I hope you will be blessed and find the best weapon for yourself. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation: 希望你能获得眷顾，找到最适合自己的武器。那么，你还想了解哪项考验？

scripts.text: Missions are not always done alone. You will often work in teams of 2 or 3 for a common goal.
scripts.translation: 任务并非总是独自完成。为了共同目标，你经常需要与两三人组队行动。

scripts.text: The battle test is only for those that pass that knowledge, survival and weapon tests. So! It is the very last test.
scripts.translation: 只有通过知识、生存和武器考验的人，才能参加战斗考验。所以，它是最后一项考验。

scripts.text: Unlike the other three tests that are done alone, you will have to compete with others in this final test.
scripts.translation: 其他三项考验都是单独进行的，而最后这项考验需要与他人竞争。

scripts.text: And only the first to get to the target passes the test.
scripts.translation: 只有第一个到达目标的人才能通过考验。

scripts.text: You'll be lucky if you have no competitors during your test.
scripts.translation: 如果你在考验中没有竞争对手，那真是走运了。

scripts.text: A challenge is better than explaining it a hundred times. It's the actual experience that makes you better.
scripts.translation: 亲身体验比解释一百遍都更有意义。正是实际经历让你变得更强。

scripts.text: Seeing is believing, so go on and take the challenge.
scripts.translation: 眼见为实，那就去接受挑战吧。

scripts.text: Let's start right away after you are done with preparations.
scripts.translation: 等你准备就绪，我们就立刻开始。

scripts.text: Since I felt happy like this. I feel young and energetic seeing young people like you challenge themselves with a new path.
scripts.translation: 看到你们这样的年轻人挑战自我、踏上新的道路，我也觉得年轻又充满活力。

scripts.text: We're done with explaining about the tests, now should I tell you my clan story?
scripts.translation: 考验都介绍完了。现在，我该给你讲讲氏族的故事了吗？

scripts.text: My clan started from two warriors.
scripts.translation: 我的氏族起源于两名战士。

scripts.text: Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation: 影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text: Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation: 胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text: The sunlight that lights up the world and the moonlight that lights up the night. Both were very similar but different warriors.
scripts.translation: 照亮世界的阳光与照亮夜晚的月光。两者非常相似，却是不同的战士。

scripts.text: There was a time there was an enmity between both warriors.
scripts.translation: 曾有一段时间，两位战士彼此为敌。

scripts.text: But it didn't take long for them to become one as a clan.
scripts.translation: 但没过多久，他们就合二为一，成为了一个氏族。

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. It is never fun to listen to the whole story all at once, no? Come back after passing a test and I'll continue my story.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，一口气听完整个故事就没意思了，对吧？通过一项考验后再回来，我会继续讲。

scripts.text: Which test will you select as your first test?
scripts.translation: 你选择哪项考验作为你的第一项考验？

scripts.text: You've passed the Test of Knowledge.
My friend doesn't approve of others that easily but I guess he liked you.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友没那么容易认可别人，不过看来他挺喜欢你的。

scripts.text: You've passed the Test of Survival.
Looks like you went through hell with this test.
scripts.translation: 看来这项考验让你吃尽了苦头。

scripts.text: You've passed the Test of Weaponry.
I wonder if Joe is satisfied with your performance.
scripts.translation: 不知道乔对你的表现是否满意。

scripts.text: Please continue with the clan story.
scripts.translation: 请继续讲述氏族的故事

scripts.text: Looks like you are pretty eager to hear more. Where did I leave off... Ah! I remember.
scripts.translation: 看来你很急切地想听后续。我讲到哪儿了...啊！我想起来了。

scripts.text: Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation: 影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text: Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation: 胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text: Both warriors weren't close at first, because personality and everything else was completely opposite of each other.
scripts.translation: 起初，两位战士并不亲近，因为他们的性格和其他方面都截然相反。

scripts.text: The first place they met was the battlefield. And you know how enemies greet each other on a battlefield.
scripts.translation: 他们第一次相遇是在战场上。你知道敌人在战场上是如何互相问候的。

scripts.text: They ended up injuring each other badly.
scripts.translation: 结果他们互相受了重伤。

scripts.text: But what can you do? War is a war.
scripts.translation: 但又能怎么办呢？战争就是战争。

scripts.text: The friend you've laughed with yesterday is a foe that you have to fight with in a war today.
scripts.translation: 昨天还与你谈笑的朋友，今天就可能成为战场上必须对抗的敌人。

scripts.text: So nobody can get along with anyone during a war.
scripts.translation: 所以战争之中，人与人之间难以和睦相处。

scripts.text: I'll continue the story after you pass another test.
scripts.translation: 等你通过另一项考验后，我再继续讲故事。

scripts.text: Which test will you choose for the second test?
scripts.translation: 第二项考验，你想选择哪一项？

scripts.text: You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Knowledge and Survival^000000!
scripts.translation: 你通过了^339CCC知识与生存考验^000000！

scripts.text: You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Knowledge and Weaponry^000000!
scripts.translation: 你通过了^339CCC知识与武器测试^000000！

scripts.text: You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Survival and Weaponry^000000!
scripts.translation: 你通过了^339CCC生存与武器测试^000000！

scripts.text: You are already done with two tests. Hope you've learned a lot from them.
scripts.translation: 你已经完成了两项测试。希望你从中学到了很多。

scripts.text: Shall we continue with the story?
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation: 影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text: Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation: 胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text: I think I left off when the two warriors met at the battlefield as enemies.
scripts.translation: 我想我上次讲到两位战士作为敌人在战场上相遇的时候。

scripts.text: The long war ended eventually but the wounds and pain of those that survived had just started.
scripts.translation: 漫长的战争终于结束了，但幸存者的伤痛才刚刚开始。

scripts.text: So these two warriors started to embrace and heal the war wounds together and became one.
scripts.translation: 于是两位战士彼此扶持，共同疗愈战争的创伤，最终结为一体。

scripts.text: There is a backstory of a man appearing in front of them and winning the loyalty from both warriors.
scripts.translation: 还有一段往事：一名男子出现在他们面前，赢得了两位战士的效忠。

scripts.text: There isn't much known about this man. Only a short mentioning of the two warriors pledging their allegiance.
scripts.translation: 关于这个人，已知的信息不多。只有关于两位战士宣誓效忠的简短记载。

scripts.text: Maybe current generations like me are the ancestors of the current Amatsu lord? But this is only an assumption.
scripts.translation: 也许包括我在内的这一代人，是现任天津城领主的祖先？不过这只是我的猜测。

scripts.text: I'm almost at the end of my clan story. Come back after you've passed the third test and I will tell you the rest.
scripts.translation: 我的氏族故事快讲完了。等你通过第三项考验后再回来，我会告诉你剩下的部分。

scripts.text: You've gone through three tests leaving only one to pass.
scripts.translation: 你已经通过三项考验，只剩最后一项了。

scripts.text: As I've told you before, the last test is different because you have to compete against others.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前所说，最后一项考验不同，因为你需要与其他人竞争。

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. I will finish the story.
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation: 影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text: Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation: 胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text: It is told that the man that earned the loyalty of the two warriors was a humorous person.
scripts.translation: 据说赢得两位战士忠诚的那个人，是个幽默的人。

scripts.text: He like the jokes and conversations better than quarrels and he liked women over men.
scripts.translation: 比起争吵，他更喜欢说笑聊天；比起男人，他更喜欢女人。

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't know why this part of the story was kept alive all these years but this man wanted to bring these two warriors together.
scripts.translation: 嗯...不知道为什么这段故事流传至今，不过那名男子确实想撮合两位战士。

scripts.text: Both warriors did travel together after the war but kept an awkward distance from each other.
scripts.translation: 战后，两位战士曾结伴旅行，却始终与彼此保持着尴尬的距离。

scripts.text: They must have had their reasons but their lord would send them out to a difficult mission together, put them in a secret room together and all sorts of situations together.
scripts.translation: 他们肯定有自己的理由，但他们的领主会派他们一起执行艰难的任务，把他们关在密室里，或者安排各种让他们在一起的情况。

scripts.text: Yes, he was. And his efforts didn't go in vain since the two warriors eventually got acquainted and married.
scripts.translation: 是的，他就是那样。他的努力没有白费，两位战士最终相识并结为夫妻。

scripts.text: This is how the clan started.
Sadly, the next part of story was purposely discontinued.
scripts.translation: 遗憾的是，故事的后半部分被人刻意删去了。

scripts.text: I think it's because someone wanted us to let go of the past and move forward.
scripts.translation: 我想是有人希望我们放下过去，继续向前。

scripts.text: That's that. Now shouldn't you be preparing for the last test?
scripts.translation: 故事就讲到这里。你现在该准备最后一项考验了吧？

scripts.text: But you must be tired from all the tests so far. Take a rest.
scripts.translation: 不过经历了这么多考验，你一定累了。休息一下吧。

scripts.text: Weren't you taking the Test of {0} just now?
scripts.translation: 你刚才不是正在参加{0}的考验吗？

scripts.text: I want to go back to test site.
The Test of {0} site is over here.
You've come back already? You could have rested more. Is there a reason to hurry?
scripts.translation: 这么快就回来了？你本可以多休息一会儿的。有什么急事吗？

scripts.text: I have to admit, I don't understand you now.
scripts.translation: 我得承认，我现在不太明白你的想法。

scripts.text: But since you've gone through much, I'm sure you will do good with the final test.
scripts.translation: 不过既然你已经经历了这么多，我相信你一定能顺利通过最后的考验。

scripts.text: Now! No more small talk. I'll let you know what the target is for the Test of Battle.
scripts.translation: 好了！不再闲聊了。我来告诉你战斗考验的目标是什么。

scripts.text: The target is a monster called the ^FF0000Clan Secret^000000.
scripts.translation: 目标是一只名叫^FF0000氏族秘密^000000的魔物。

scripts.text: You will have to be careful because there are many similiar shaped and named monsters in test site.
scripts.translation: 你要小心，考验场里有许多外形和名称都很相似的魔物。

scripts.text: And if you are lucky, there will be others targeting the monster.
scripts.translation: 而且如果你运气好，还会有其他人也在攻击这只魔物。

scripts.text: May the blessings of '{0}' be with you.
Then let's go to the battle test field.
scripts.translation: 那么，让我们去战斗考验场吧。

scripts.text: I see you are in the middle of the ^339CCCTest of Battle^000000. Will you go back to the test site?
scripts.translation: 看来你正在参加^339CCC战斗考验^000000。要回到考验地点吗？

scripts.text: Go back to the test site.
The test site is over here.
You should not be here. Leave!
scripts.translation: 你不该出现在这里。离开！

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. You'll know when we get there. The Test of Knowledge is taken over here.
scripts.translation: 哈哈。到了那里你就知道了。知识考验在那边进行。

scripts.text: But I believe you can handle it. The Test of Survival is taken over here.
scripts.translation: 不过我相信你能应付得来。生存考验在那边进行。

scripts.text: You receive 5 Iron Ore and 1 Phracon.
scripts.translation: 你获得了5个铁矿石和1个强化武器金属-级数一。

scripts.text: You will find these useful. The Test of Weaponry is taken over here.
scripts.translation: 这些对你会有用的。武器考验在那边进行。

scripts.text: Sorry, your clan is not same as ours, is there something wrong?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你的氏族和我们的不一样，有什么事吗？

scripts.text: This is a test of knowledge, so why did you bring so many things?
scripts.translation: 这是知识考验，你为什么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text: I remember you from before looking for the way of the ninja.
scripts.translation: 我记得你，之前你在寻找忍者的道路。
你已经变得这么强了吗？

scripts.text: A truly determined youth! I like that.
scripts.translation: 真是有决心的年轻人！我喜欢。

scripts.text: Good! The test you are about to take is the ^339CCCTest of Knowledge^000000.
scripts.translation: 很好！你即将参加的是^339CCC知识考验^000000。

scripts.text: I hope you haven't been lazy with your studies while focusing on getting stronger?
scripts.translation: 希望你没有因为专注于变强而疏于学习？

scripts.text: That's a relief. Let me know when you are ready to start the test.
scripts.translation: 那就好。准备好开始考验时告诉我。

scripts.text: So you were all talk? Well, let me know when you are ready then.
scripts.translation: 原来你只是嘴上说说？那等你准备好了再告诉我。

scripts.text: I'm ready at my end. Are you ready for the test?
scripts.translation: 我这边已经准备好了。你准备好考验了吗？

scripts.text: Well, what can I do but wait for you.
This isn't your first test, is it?
scripts.translation: 这不是你第一次接受考验了吧？

scripts.text: You only need to choose the correct answer to my questions.
scripts.translation: 你只需要对我的问题做出正确的回答即可。

scripts.text: You're through all 10 questions. Wasn't so bad! The important part starts now.
scripts.translation: 你答完了全部10道题。还不错嘛！真正的考验现在才开始。

scripts.text: Can't believe someone who is taking a new path can be so pathetic.
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信，一个正在走新道路的人竟然如此无能。

scripts.text: You will take the test again with new questions. Better pass it this time.
scripts.translation: 你将用新的题目重新接受考验。这次最好能及格。

scripts.text: Well, looks like you weren't lazy with your studies.
scripts.translation: 看来你并没有偷懒学习啊。

scripts.text: What? Proud of yourself for solving these questions?
scripts.translation: 怎么？解出这些题就沾沾自喜了？

scripts.text: You still have a long way to go and this is only a small fraction of it.
scripts.translation: 你还有很长的路要走，而这只是其中的一小部分。

scripts.text: Well... I'm curious how far your strong will can take you through other tests.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我很好奇，凭借你坚强的意志，还能在其他考验中走多远。

scripts.text: I'll let you go now so go report back to Leader Gion with your results.
scripts.translation: 现在你可以走了，去首领吉翁那里汇报你的结果吧。

scripts.text: I'll let you go now so go report back to Leader Gion with your results.
scripts.translation: 现在你可以走了，去首领吉翁那里汇报你的结果吧。

scripts.text: The Test of Survival starts from here and you use ^FD0260100 Life Points (LP)^000000 and roll dice to advance forward through the test.
scripts.translation: 生存考验从这里开始，你将使用^FD0260100点生命点数（LP）^000000并掷骰子，以在考验中前进。

scripts.text: The whole test starts from block 0 to block 40 and each block you get can either give or take your LP.
scripts.translation: 整个考验从第0格到第40格，每经过一格，你的LP可能会增加或减少。

scripts.text: You need to have some ^FD0260LP^000000 till you get to the arrival block at the end to pass the test.
scripts.translation: 你需要保留一些^FD0260LP^000000，直到到达终点，才能通过考验。

scripts.text: But! You still pass the test if your ^FD0260LP^000000 becomes 0 when you get to the arrival block.
scripts.translation: 但是！即使你到达终点时^FD0260LP^000000变为0，仍然可以通过考验。

scripts.text: Game instructions end here. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation: 游戏说明到此结束。祝你好运。

You are really bad at rolling dice. How can you get a 1 from the start? You can move to block 9 if you pay up 10 LP in this block.
scripts.translation: 你掷骰子的运气真差。一开始就掷出1？如果你支付10点LP，就可以移动到第9格。

scripts.translation: 既然参加考验是特别的事情，我该留下我的名字吗？

scripts.translation: 如果点数相同，就能前往第30格；如果不同，则再消耗2点LP重掷...直到两次点数相同为止。

scripts.translation: 放弃所有剩余的^FD0260LP^000000并返回第0格，这样下一位参加考验的人就能直接通过。

scripts.text: Do you want to leave your ^FD0260LP^000000?
If you leave your ^FD0260LP^000000 then the next person for test that arrives at the block will automatically pass the test.
scripts.translation: 如果你放弃^FD0260LP^000000，那么下一位到达该格子的考验者将自动通过考验。

scripts.text: Leave all remaining ^FD0260LP^000000 here. Press Close and go back to block 0.
scripts.translation: 请在此处放弃所有剩余的^FD0260LP^000000。点击关闭并回到第0格。

scripts.translation: 前一位考验者已放弃所有^FD0260LP^000000。点击“关闭”前往最后一格。

If the sum of the numbers from both dice is larger than 8, then you can move to any block between 25 to 30. But! If the sum is below 8, you must move back to block 19.

scripts.translation: 看不懂上面的字，应该有办法读懂才对。

scripts.translation: 尝试了一个最近的普隆德拉笑话来做点什么。

scripts.translation: 被诅咒了，无法移动2分钟。

scripts.text: Its a wise decision to do nothing.

scripts.translation: 什么都没发生。还是需要做些什么。

scripts.translation: 掷出1、2或3，直接前往终点；掷出4、5或6，则可选择移动到第29格。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the end.

scripts.text: If you get 1, 3, or 5, move to the arrival point; if you get 2, 4, or 6, go back to the starting point.
scripts.translation: 如果掷出1、3或5，移动到终点；如果掷出2、4或6，回到起点。

scripts.translation: 现在距离终点只剩1格了。恭喜你能走到这里。

scripts.translation: 但你不能这么轻易地过去。如果掷出3，你将回到第3格。

scripts.text: You must be here by mistake.

To those you are preparing for a new turn...
scripts.translation: 给那些正准备开始新一轮的人...

scripts.text: Well begun is half done. However always remember it is not the end.
scripts.translation: 好的开始是成功的一半。但请记住，这还不是结束。

scripts.text: Let's read all the writing on the sign.
scripts.translation: 让我们读一读标示上的所有文字。

scripts.text: You feel like you are moved to another place.
scripts.translation: 你感觉自己仿佛被传送到了另一个地方。

scripts.text: Go reduce your weight! This test will be too difficult otherwise...
scripts.translation: 去减减肥！不然这考验会很难通过...

scripts.text: Sorry, your clan is not the same as ours, is there something wrong?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你的氏族不是我们的，是不是有什么误会？

scripts.text: You are not supposed to be here...
It's my duty to get rid of you,
so I'll send you back now!
scripts.translation: 所以我现在就把你送回去！

scripts.text: You aren't surprised I'm here. Did you meet ^0237FDKuuga Gai^000000 before coming here?
scripts.translation: 你看到我在这里似乎一点也不惊讶。来之前见过^0237FD空牙·盖^000000吗？

scripts.text: Don't like it that I'm not the first one you visited but that is not important.
scripts.translation: 我不喜欢你没先拜访我，但这并不重要。

scripts.text: Welcome to the workshop where weapons are created for the clan.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到为氏族打造武器的工坊。

scripts.text: Our clan has been creating and using unique weapons to serve our secret missions since ancient times.
scripts.translation: 自古以来，我们的氏族就一直在制造和使用独特的武器，以执行秘密任务。

scripts.text: Hmm? You are not as slow as I thought you were!
scripts.translation: 嗯？你并不像我想象中那么迟钝！

scripts.text: Yes. Einbroch is known as an industrial city, the city of great blacksmiths create new technology.
scripts.translation: 没错。艾音布罗克以工业城市闻名，城里的优秀铁匠不断创造新技术。

scripts.text: My mission is to analyze their technology and report back to the clan.
scripts.translation: 我的任务是解析他们的技术，并向氏族汇报。

scripts.text: I spoke more than I intended to.
Did you bring enough ^6848B7Iron Ore, Iron, Steel, Phracon, Emveretaron, Rough Oridecon, and Rough Elunium^000000?
scripts.translation: 你带了足够的^6848B7铁矿石、铁、钢、强化武器金属-级数一、强化武器金属-级数二、神之金属原石和铝原石^000000吗？

scripts.text: Let's now create a new prototype weapon.
scripts.translation: 现在来制作一把新武器的原型吧。

scripts.text: Feel free to use tools from here, and...
scripts.translation: 请随意使用这里的工具，还有...
...以及其他地方。现在让我们开始吧！！

scripts.text: Hmm... Interesting... Is it a dagger in a shape of a Kunai?
scripts.translation: 嗯...有意思...这是做成苦无形状的短剑吗？

scripts.text: Hmm... Is this an Ordinary Huuma?
scripts.translation: 嗯...这是普通的风魔手里剑吗？

scripts.text: Ahh, Its not an Ordinary Huuma.
scripts.translation: 啊，这可不是普通的风魔手里剑。

scripts.text: Ahh, how is it possible? You don't have weapons? Maybe you equipped it?
scripts.translation: 啊，怎么会这样？你身上没有武器吗？是不是已经装备上了？

scripts.text: Very creative. I do see room for improvement but the weapon itself may come out useful after smoothing it out a bit.
scripts.translation: 很有创意。还有改进空间，不过稍加打磨后，这把武器或许会派上用场。

scripts.text: Good. I think you are ready.
scripts.translation: 很好。我觉得你准备好了。

scripts.text: There are refinement tools on both sides of me. Use those to refine a weapon and come back.
scripts.translation: 我两边都有精炼工具。用它们精炼一件武器后再回来。

scripts.text: I created the refinement tools myself with great effort so you won't have any trouble using them.
scripts.translation: 这些精炼工具是我费心亲手制作的，用起来不会有问题。

scripts.text: ^FF0000be careful not to cause trouble by showing these to blacksmiths outside of here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000别把这些工具拿给外面的铁匠看，免得惹出麻烦。^000000

scripts.text: Did you get a successful result?
scripts.translation: 你得到满意的结果了吗？

scripts.text: It isn't easy to get a satisfactory result at first.
scripts.translation: 一开始很难得到满意的结果。

scripts.text: You've lost the weapon even with my warning.
scripts.translation: 即使我警告过你，你还是失去了武器。

scripts.text: Nothing else we can do. Wait!
Red Leopard Joe mumbles something and suddenly all weapons are unequipped.
scripts.translation: 红豹乔嘟囔了几句，突然把你装备的所有武器都卸了下来。

scripts.text: What is this? You still have the prototype. Stop playing around.
scripts.translation: 这是什么？你的原型武器还在，别闹了。

scripts.text: Well! Lets try to make it again!
Looks like you've got some results.
Ahh! You have not equipped any weapons!
scripts.translation: 啊！你没有装备任何武器！

scripts.text: Is that weapon yours? Let me have a look.
scripts.translation: 那把武器是你的吗？让我看看。

scripts.text: Are you certain it's that weapon?
You plan to trick me with that? Again!!
scripts.translation: 你想拿那个骗我吗？又来这套！！

scripts.text: Joe took a thorough look at the seal.
scripts.translation: 乔仔细检查了武器上的印记。

scripts.text: I must have misjudged you. You might have been satisfied yourself but I'm not. Do it again!!
scripts.translation: 看来是我看错你了。你或许觉得自己做得不错，但我不满意。再做一次！！

scripts.text: You've just made it that close to passing. I will ask one more time, are you satisfied?
scripts.translation: 你已经差一点就通过了。我再问一次，你满意了吗？

scripts.text: I still believe that you will not stop here.
scripts.translation: 我依然相信你不会止步于此。

scripts.text: I will look forward for your result.
For beginners, quite good. This test may not be significant to you, but your competence is enough.
scripts.translation: 对初学者来说，这已经相当不错。考验对你或许不算什么，但你的本事已经够了。

scripts.text: I will take this weapon to give it some finishing touches.
scripts.translation: 我会把这件武器拿去做最后的修整。

scripts.text: Go report the test results to Gion!
scripts.translation: 快去向吉翁汇报考验结果！

scripts.text: You should not have come here...
It's my duty to get rid of you.
Are you done making the prototype of the new weapons?
scripts.translation: 新武器的原型制作好了吗？

scripts.text: How do you expect me to make a weapon?{0}
scripts.translation: 你指望我怎么制作武器？{0}

scripts.text: Feel free to use tools from here, and...
scripts.translation: 请随意使用这里的工具，还有...

scripts.text: Then we'll have to pay a visit to the village. Try the ^FF0000drawer^000000 over there. It'll take you to the village.
scripts.translation: 那我们得去一趟村庄。试试那边的^FF0000抽屉^000000，那里能通往村庄。

scripts.text: Hmm... Guess I expected too much? Let me explain.
scripts.translation: 嗯...看来是我期望太高了？让我解释一下。

scripts.text: You first have to melt the ore to use for the weapon. And the best way to get high purity metal is to melt materials that are of the same kind.
scripts.translation: 首先要熔炼矿石，才能用来制作武器。想要得到高纯度金属，最好把同类材料一起熔炼。

scripts.text: For example, Iron Ore, Iron, and Steel are of similar property so you can get a high purity metal out of them.
scripts.translation: 例如，铁矿石、铁和钢的性质相似，因此可以从中获得高纯度金属。

scripts.text: Once you've melted a high purity metal, pour it in a mold to get the shape of the weapon and then make it firm through grinding and tempering.
scripts.translation: 一旦熔炼出高纯度金属，将其倒入模具中形成武器的形状，然后通过研磨和淬火使其定型。

scripts.text: By the way, you will get the best results by thoroughly rotating, grinding and tempering.
scripts.translation: 顺便说一句，充分进行旋转、研磨和淬火，你会得到最好的效果。

scripts.text: I think this is enough to get you started, don't you think? Now go and work on that prototype!!
scripts.translation: 我觉得这些足以让你入门了，你觉得呢？现在去制作那个原型吧！！

scripts.text: There is some kind of device on the drawer.
Too heavy! Please reduce your weight.
scripts.translation: 太重了！请减轻你的重量。

scripts.text: First need to melt metals like iron and iron ore to use to create a weapon.
scripts.translation: 首先要熔炼铁矿石、铁等金属，才能用来制作武器。
熔炼强化武器金属-级数一
熔炼强化武器金属-级数二

scripts.text: Which metal will be melted next?
scripts.translation: 接下来要熔炼哪种金属？

scripts.text: Now the metal is melted to use for creating weapons.
scripts.translation: 现在金属已经熔化，可以用来制作武器了。

scripts.text: Next is to make the melted metal firm by pouring it into a mold. Which mold shape will you use?
scripts.translation: 接下来是将熔化的金属倒入模具中使其定型。你打算使用哪种形状的模具？

scripts.text: Poured the melted metal into the dagger mold.
scripts.translation: 将熔化的金属倒入了短剑模具中。

scripts.text: Poured the melted metal into the shuriken mold.
scripts.translation: 将熔化的金属倒入了飞镖模具中。

scripts.text: Looks like the metal is taking shape. Now what next?
scripts.translation: 看起来金属正在成型。接下来该做什么？

scripts.text: Start to sharpen the tool using a whetstone for finishing touches.
scripts.translation: 开始使用磨刀石进行最后的打磨。

scripts.text: Let's take it to Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation: 让我们把它带给红豹乔。

scripts.text: The weapon was destroyed while doing the finishing touches to it.
scripts.translation: 在进行最后的打磨时，武器被损坏了。

scripts.text: There must have been something missed while creating the weapon. Very sad this happened but you'll have to start all over again.
scripts.translation: 制作武器时一定有什么地方疏忽了。虽然很遗憾，但你不得不重新开始。

scripts.text: But you do not have any more metal to melt. Let's try again after getting more metal.
scripts.translation: 但是你没有更多可以熔炼的金属了。等获取更多金属后再试试吧。

scripts.text: This tool helps you refine your weapons automatically. However, you won't need this just now.
scripts.translation: 这个工具可以自动帮你精炼武器。不过，你现在还用不上它。

scripts.text: You turn on the refinement tool.
The equipment starts up with a pleasant vibration.
scripts.translation: 设备伴随着令人愉悦的震动开始运转。

scripts.text: Looks like you can use the tool right away for refinement because it holds a good deal of Elunium and Oridecon within it.
scripts.translation: 看起来你可以立即使用这个工具进行精炼，因为它内部含有大量的铝和神之金属。

scripts.text: A warning beep comes from the tool.
This equipment does not work without an equipped item to refine.
scripts.translation: 如果没有装备待精炼的物品，这台设备无法工作。

scripts.text: Wait... this weapon is not a customized one.
scripts.translation: 等等...这把武器不是定制武器。

scripts.text: Why don't you refine this with those hot-headed blacksmiths out there?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不去找外面那些脾气火爆的铁匠精炼呢？

scripts.text: A warning beep comes from the tool.
That weapon cannot be refined. Where did you get it?
scripts.translation: 这把武器无法精炼。你是从哪里弄来的？

scripts.text: A warning beep comes from the tool.
This equipment is perfectly refined. Keep it for yourself!
scripts.translation: 这件装备已经完美精炼了。请留作自用吧！

scripts.text: This is very well refined equipment. Do you want to continue? Refine skill decreases by 1 if refinement fails.
scripts.translation: 这是一件精炼度很高的装备。你确定要继续吗？如果精炼失败，精炼技能将降低1点。

scripts.text: Your weapon refinement skill dropped by 1.
scripts.translation: 你的武器精炼技能下降了1点。

scripts.text: You don't need so many things now!
scripts.translation: 你现在不需要这么多东西了！

scripts.text: Looks like you haven't taken care of the target yet.
scripts.translation: 看来你还没有处理掉目标。

scripts.text: I'll tell you once more. The target is the ^FF0000Clan Secret^000000.
scripts.translation: 我再告诉你一次。目标是^FF0000氏族秘密^000000。

scripts.text: Of course the path will be difficult, so continue searching!
scripts.translation: 当然，路途会很艰难，所以请继续寻找！

scripts.text: Looks like you've taken care of the target. Hmm.
scripts.translation: 看来你已经处理掉目标了。嗯。

scripts.text: But please get down from your frog. Otherwise I can't continue!
scripts.translation: 不过请先从青蛙坐骑上下来，否则我没法继续！

scripts.text: How did you get weaker? Come back once you've regained your previous levels.
scripts.translation: 你怎么变弱了？等你恢复到之前的等级后再回来吧。

scripts.text: Please come back after using all your Skill Points.
scripts.translation: 请在使用完所有技能点后再回来。

scripts.text: The Test of Battle will be put off for a while. Don't worry because this does not have affect to other tests.
scripts.translation: 战斗考验将暂时延期。别担心，这不会影响其他考验。

scripts.text: My friend {0} made it to {1} Path. Congratulations!!
scripts.translation: 我的朋友{0}通过了{1}之路。恭喜！！

scripts.text: It is pleasant to meet a youth that is walking through a new path.
scripts.translation: 很高兴见到一位正在探索新道路的年轻人。

scripts.text: I'm sorry I almost forgot about you two. Do you have anything to share with {0}?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我差点忘了你们两个。你们有什么想对{0}说的吗？

scripts.text: Hmm... Embarrassing... to speak so suddenly...
scripts.translation: 嗯...突然说这些...真让人难为情...

scripts.text: {0}, you are now a proud member of our clan. Always hold your head high and...
scripts.translation: {0}，你现在是我们氏族引以为傲的成员。请永远昂首挺胸，并且...

scripts.text: I'm sorry I strangled you when we first met.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，初次见面时我掐了你的脖子。

scripts.text: Puhahaha! Gai is all talk. I know I was know valuable to you than that Gai.
scripts.translation: 噗哈哈！盖只会说大话。我知道自己比盖更有用。

scripts.text: I did some work on the prototype {0} you made.
scripts.translation: 我把你制作的{0}原型稍微加工了一下。

scripts.text: {0} now shines beautifully with a scarlet glow after I did the finishing touches.
scripts.translation: 经过我的最后修饰，{0}现在闪耀着美丽的猩红光芒。

scripts.text: I named your weapons on my own but I know you'll like the name.
scripts.translation: 我擅自给你的武器起了名字，但我相信你会喜欢的。

scripts.text: I don't have much to add because Gai and Joe said it all.
scripts.translation: 盖和乔已经把话说完了，我没什么要补充的。

scripts.text: I'm just sorry that the environment of all these tests could have been better for our later generation.
scripts.translation: 我只是很遗憾，这些考验的环境本可以更好，以便造福我们的后代。

scripts.text: You only need to look forward and never turn back.
scripts.translation: 你只需要向前看，不要回头。

scripts.text: I hope the blessings of Kagerou, dancing sun and Oboro, misty moonlight will be with you on your journey ahead.
scripts.translation: 愿舞动如烈阳的影狼与朦胧如月光的胧，护佑你的前路。

scripts.text: I hope the blessings of Kagerou, dancing sun and Oboro, misty moonlight will be with you on your journey ahead.
scripts.translation: 愿舞动如烈阳的影狼与朦胧如月光的胧，护佑你的前路。

scripts.text: You should not be here. Please leave!
Congratulation for choosing the road of development!
scripts.translation: 祝贺你选择了这条成长之路！

scripts.text: You have not found the target? Continue searching it.
scripts.translation: 还没找到目标吗？继续寻找。

scripts.text: This is the Battle Test Control NPC.
This is the Kagerou and Oboro Job Change assistant NPC.
scripts.translation: 这是影狼和胧转职助手NPC。

scripts.text: I can solve any problems in the job change quest.
scripts.translation: 我可以解决转职任务中的任何问题。
变量状态（当前值/最大值）
任务状态（当前值/最大值）

scripts.text: Which test do you want to set as completed?
scripts.translation: 你想要将哪项考验设为已完成？

scripts.text: Three tests must be completed before changing jobs. If you wish to reach a job change state, please select [Pre-Transfer] directly from the previous menu!
scripts.translation: 转职前必须完成三项考验。如果你希望达到转职状态，请直接从上一级菜单选择[转职前准备]！

scripts.text: The Test of Knowledge has been set as complete. I hope you have finished your initialization.
scripts.translation: 知识考验已设为完成。希望你已完成初始化。

scripts.text: The Test of Survival has been set as complete. I hope you have finished your initialization.
scripts.translation: 生存考验已设为完成。希望你已完成初始化。

scripts.text: The Test of Weaponry has been set as complete. I hope you have finished your initialization.
scripts.translation: 武器考验已设为完成。希望你已完成初始化。

scripts.text: I will change your quest status to Pre-Transfer, but before that...
scripts.translation: 我将把你的任务状态改为“转职前准备”，但在此之前...

scripts.text: I've set the Pre-Transfer status. Good luck!!
scripts.translation: 已设置“转职前准备”状态。祝你好运！！

scripts.text: The task of initialization is complete. You can confirm this through the [Current Status] option!
scripts.translation: 初始化任务已完成。你可以通过[当前状态]选项确认！
